metadata.title: Aika World – Systems
metadata.description: Learn about the systems that power the world of Aika and see how they influence the story and play.

title: Systems
intro: The systems of Aika World respond to player decisions and the rhythm of the story so every adventure feels distinct.

magic.title: Ethereal magic
magic.description: The flow of aether keeps magic in balance, yet every spell leaves a mark on the fabric of the world.
magic.impact: Overuse can trigger distortions, forcing mages to wield their power responsibly.

technology.title: Ancient technology
technology.description: The machinery of lost civilizations awakens for those who decipher forgotten codes and rites.
technology.impact: Maintaining balance between technology and magic is vital for the world's stability.

economy.title: Living economy
economy.description: Trade routes and faction influence shift constantly in response to player choices.
economy.impact: Every deal or alliance shapes the narrative, opening new opportunities or sparking conflict.
